name: Cape Canaveral Launch Complex 17 (LC-17)
tagline: Thor and Delta pad pair: Spirit, Opportunity, Pathfinder, MESSENGER, Dawn; demolished in 2018
description: Two Thor-lineage pads, 17A and 17B, near the beach at Cape Canaveral. The Air Force built them in 1956 for the Thor missile, then upgraded them in the early 1960s for Thor-derived rockets, which became the Delta family. Pioneer 0, an attempted lunar orbiter, was lost here on 17 August 1958 when its Thor-Able exploded 73.6 seconds after liftoff. In the Delta II years the pads sent NASA probes to Mars and beyond: NEAR Shoemaker and Mars Pathfinder in 1996, Spirit and Opportunity in 2003, MESSENGER in 2004, Phoenix and Dawn in 2007. The Delta III flew three times from 17B between 1998 and 2000 before the programme was abandoned. The last launch was GRAIL on 10 September 2011, and both towers were demolished on 12 July 2018.
